known_limitations: Not an atomic source-tree snapshot; changes, pending files and unplanned new paths are explicit.
Current duplicate checkpoint aliases are rehashed, so all 365.6GB checkpoint source bytes are reread during packing.
Compression disk failures preserve a per-file/group recovery journal and partial manifest; uncommitted tar groups are not claimed restorable.
Text SHA mismatch skips that path as pending/missing and continues; archive is not marked complete.
Source .git is excluded and requires the separately prepared git bundle.
